The growth of the etched cavities was simulated with a three-dimensional, rejection-free kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) model based on the n-fold-way algorithm of Bortz, Kalos and Lebowitz.
The model is phenomenological: it reproduces the measured cavity geometry with a small set of effective rates, not with a derived dissolution mechanism.
The model has no etchant transport, no crystallographic detail beyond the ratio ry, and no undercutting, and most of its parameters were set by hand.
